_comment: Shared cross-language pin for conversation-only evidence (AL-1.6c).
BOTH implementations assert against this file:
They must agree token-for-token: the bot writes labels with the TS
normalizer, the memory-evidence path writes them with the Python one,
and recurrence compares the two to each other. A token added to one
vocabulary and not the other would silently halve the detector's
recall, so the vocabularies themselves are pinned here, not just the

normalize_cases.name: design-example ask normalizes to the design's own label head
normalize_cases.input: Can you give me my morning summary please?

normalize_cases.name: politeness and framing collapse to the same key
normalize_cases.input: morning summary

normalize_cases.name: cron-prefixed synthetic turn is refused
normalize_cases.input: [cron:2ac901db] run the content schedule watcher

normalize_cases.name: heartbeat sentinel is refused
normalize_cases.input: HEARTBEAT_OK

normalize_cases.name: no-reply sentinel is refused
normalize_cases.input: NO_REPLY

normalize_cases.name: thanks alone is too thin
normalize_cases.input: thanks!

normalize_cases.name: dates and relative days are dropped, subject survives
normalize_cases.input: What's on my calendar today and tomorrow? Check email at 9am.

normalize_cases.name: greeting and cadence adverb dropped, subject survives
normalize_cases.input: Good morning! Please send me the daily standup notes for the team.

normalize_cases.name: non-latin script yields no key rather than a garbage one
normalize_cases.input: おはよう、今日の予定を教えて

normalize_cases.name: repeated tokens are de-duplicated in first-seen order
normalize_cases.input: summary summary summary of my email email

normalize_cases.name: digits cannot survive into a label
normalize_cases.input: give me the sales report for 2026-08-19

normalize_cases.name: a single content token is below the floor
normalize_cases.input: weather

normalize_cases.name: label is capped at MAX_LABEL_TOKENS
normalize_cases.input: alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot golf
normalize_cases.expected: alpha bravo charlie delta echo foxtrot

normalize_cases.name: tokens shorter than three characters are dropped
normalize_cases.input: an ai bot summary report

normalize_cases.name: empty string yields no key
whitespace only yields no key
null input yields no key
non-string input yields no key
markdown and emoji are separators; cadence adverbs still drop
normalize_cases.input: **Please** send the _weekly_ revenue digest 🚀

normalize_cases.name: a URL contributes only its alphabetic runs
normalize_cases.input: pull https://example.com/reports/q3 revenue digest
normalize_cases.expected: pull https example com reports revenue
